## Validation

- [ ] `uv run ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run pytest`
- [ ] `uvx ty check src` reviewed when applicable

## Compatibility and release impact

- [ ] Public API behavior reviewed.
- [ ] Workflow JSON compatibility or migration impact documented.
- [ ] Dependency, platform, packaging, or native-payload impact documented.
- [ ] `docs/changelog.md` updated for user-visible changes.

## Provenance and security

- [ ] No secrets, private paths, customer data, or local artifacts are included.
- [ ] Copied or adapted material has compatible licensing and required notices.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior and threat-model impact are documented.
- [ ] Commits are signed off under the DCO policy.
